notes: run.py builds a repo per run from `fixture`, runs `prompt` with `claude -p`, and grade.py applies `common_checks` plus each eval's `checks`. `{key}` in a prompt is a `key=value` line from the fixture's stdout. Check types are in grade.py. `file` and `any`/`all`/`none` values are case-insensitive regexes. A finding matches when it matches `any` and `all`, and no `none` pattern. `lines` is an inclusive range that must overlap the finding's `file:line`.

common_checks.text: Report starts with title, TL;DR, and Counts lines
Report has all header lines and the Review guide and Findings sections
Each finding id has its section letter, ids are unique, ordinals run 1..n per section
Counts line matches the number of findings per section
Each (adjacent) finding is medium or low and states a count
Final reply lists every finding id of the report
Final reply has no Counts line and no `Then:` line
Structure section, when present, has a legend line, no code, no mixed edge marks, no text lines, at most 4 nodes in a row, and the final reply has the diagram
High-impact section is omitted when empty, and the final reply lists its items
No file write except the report
Repo refs, HEAD, worktree, and stash did not change
